statements.subject: server
statements.description: In case any of the feature tags listed by the Require header are not supported by the server or client receiving the request, it MUST respond to the request using the error code 551 (Option Not Supported) and include the Unsupported header listing those feature tags that are NOT supported.
statements.pre_cond: request.Require != null & server.supported_features does not include all(request.Require)
actions: include Unsupported header listing unsupported feature tags
